name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density_empty
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N), RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density ∅ σ = 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap_empty
type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap ∅ ∅ = 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.tv_le_nonempty_graph
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K),
  RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
    RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω ≠ ∅

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.nonempty_graph_has_collision
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω ≠ ∅ → ∃ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.occupancyUnion_le_chooseMoment
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype W] (P : PMF Ω) (X : W → Ω → ℕ) (q : ℕ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ∃ (w : W), q ≤ X w ω) ≤
    ∑ w : W, RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => ↑((X w ω).choose q)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordBinomialMoment
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K),
  ∀ q ≤ N,
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ↑((RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω).choose q)) =
      ↑(N.choose q) *
        ∏ j : Fin K, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) q / RiffleLowerV2.falling N q

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.collisionUpper
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K),
  2 ≤ N →
    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
      ↑(N.choose 2) * ∏ j : Fin K, ∑ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) 2 / RiffleLowerV2.falling N 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.columnCollision_le_exp_cost
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (j : Fin K),
  ∑ a : Fin k, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j a) 2 / RiffleLowerV2.falling N 2 ≤
    Real.exp (-TimeProfile.psi (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts hN j) 2)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.collisionUpper_exponential
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 2 ≤ N),
  RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
    ↑(N.choose 2) * Real.exp (-∑ j : Fin K, TimeProfile.psi (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts ⋯ j) 2)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.collisionUpper_polynomial
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 2 ≤ N) (ζ : ℝ),
  (2 + ζ) * Real.log ↑N ≤ ∑ j : Fin K, TimeProfile.psi (TimeProfile.Cuts.profile cuts ⋯ j) 2 →
    RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤ ↑N ^ (-ζ) / 2

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.shuffle_componentSize
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts) (i : Fin N),
  {j : Fin N |
        RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) j =
          RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) i}.card =
    RiffleLowerV2.wordCount (RiffleUpperV2.sortedWord ω i) ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponents_shuffle_iff
type:
∀ {k N K B : ℕ} {cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) B ↔
    ∀ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω ≤ B

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.not_boundedComponents_shuffle
type:
∀ {k N K B : ℕ} {cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K} (ω : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts),
  ¬RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) B ↔
    ∃ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), B + 1 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.centralBinomial_one_le
type: ∀ (B : ℕ), 1 ≤ ↑(B.choose (B / 2))

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponentTail_factorial
type:
∀ {k N K B : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  1 ≤ B →
    (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ¬RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) B) ≤
      ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN ^ B / ↑(B + 1).factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.exists_boundedComponentTail
type:
∀ (η A : ℝ),
  0 < η →
    ∃ (B : ℕ),
      2 ≤ B ∧
        ∀ (k N K : ℕ) (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 2 ≤ N),
          RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts ⋯ ≤ ↑N ^ (-η) →
            (RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                ¬RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) B) ≤
              ↑N ^ (-A) / ↑(B + 1).factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.graphLaw
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → PMF (RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N → ℝ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density_nonneg
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N), 0 ≤ RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density G σ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.uniform_mass
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  ((RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) σ).toReal = 1 / ↑(Fintype.card (RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N))

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.graphLaw_mass
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  ((RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.graphLaw G) σ).toReal =
    RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density G σ / ↑(Fintype.card (RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N))

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.graphLaw_density
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  ((RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.graphLaw G) σ).toReal =
    ((RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) σ).toReal * RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density G σ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density_normalized
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) (RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density G) = 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.increasing_probability
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleLowerV2.probability (RiffleLowerV2.uniformPermutation N) (RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G) =
    1 / ↑(RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → ℝ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap_nonneg
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N), 0 ≤ RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap G H

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlapIdentity
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap G H =
    ↑(RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G) * ↑(RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial H) /
      ↑(RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial (G ∪ H))

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponents_population
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N), RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents G N

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.edgeDisjointOverlap
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N), Disjoint G H → RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap G H ≤ 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.edgeDisjointFactorial
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  Disjoint G H →
    RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G * RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial H ≤
      RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial (G ∪ H)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runFactorial_aux
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ), (a + 1).factorial * (b + 1).factorial ≤ (a + b + 1).factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runFactorial
type: ∀ (a b : ℕ), 0 < a → 0 < b → a.factorial * b.factorial ≤ (a + b - 1).factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.descFactorial_ratio_le_pow
type: ∀ {N m : ℕ}, m ≤ N → ∀ (r : ℕ), ↑(m.descFactorial r) / ↑(N.descFactorial r) ≤ (↑m / ↑N) ^ r

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordFactorialMoment
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  ∀ q ≤ N,
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) q) =
      RiffleLowerV2.falling N q *
        ∏ j : Fin K, RiffleLowerV2.falling (cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) q / RiffleLowerV2.falling N q

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordMass_eq_prod
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w = ∏ j : Fin K, ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j)) / ↑N

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordMass_nonneg
type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.count_le_population
type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), cuts.count j a ≤ N

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordFactorialMoment_le
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  ∀ q ≤ N,
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) q) ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.falling N q * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ^ q

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordBinomialMoment_le
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  ∀ q ≤ N,
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ↑((RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω).choose q)) ≤
      ↑(N.choose q) * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ^ q

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordMass_sum
type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K), 0 < N → ∑ w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K, RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w = 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordMass_le_maximalMean_div
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN / ↑N

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.wordCount_le_population
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω ≤ N

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.largestComponentTail_zero
type:
∀ {k N K q : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  N < q →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ∃ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K), q ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) =
      0

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.largestComponentTail_sum
type:
∀ {k N K q : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  q ≤ N →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ∃ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K), q ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) ≤
      ↑(N.choose q) * ∑ w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K, RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ^ q

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.largestComponentTail
type:
∀ {k N K q : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ q →
    q ≤ N →
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          ∃ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K), q ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) ≤
        ↑(N.choose q) * (RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN / ↑N) ^ (q - 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → Fin N → Fin (N + 1)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey_eq_iff
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (i j : Fin N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G i = RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G j ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → ℕ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial_pos
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N), 0 < RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFiberEquiv
type:
{N : ℕ} →
  (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) →
    (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N) →
      RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G σ →
        RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber G σ ≃
          RiffleLowerV2.Model.KeyAssignmentFiber (RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G)
            (RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G ∘ ⇑(Equiv.symm σ))

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentSort_fiber_card
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G σ →
    Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber G σ) = RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentSort_fiber_card_eq
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  Fintype.card (RiffleLowerV2.Model.ComponentSortFiber G σ) =
    if RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G σ then RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.expect_comm
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (f ω)) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (γ : Γ) => RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω γ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.expect_product
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (f : Ω → ℝ) (g : Γ → ℝ),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect P f * RiffleLowerV2.expect Q g =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (γ : Γ) => f ω * g γ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.expect_abs_le_sqrt
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => |f ω|) ≤ √(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω ^ 2)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.probability_compl
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω) = 1 - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.choose_mul_ratio_pow_le
type: ∀ {N q : ℕ}, 0 < N → 1 ≤ q → ∀ {μ : ℝ}, 0 ≤ μ → ↑(N.choose q) * (μ / ↑N) ^ (q - 1) ≤ ↑N * μ ^ (q - 1) / ↑q.factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.maximalMean_nonneg
type: ∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N), 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.largestComponentTail_factorial
type:
∀ {k N K q : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 0 < N),
  2 ≤ q →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        ∃ (w : RiffleUpperV2.Word k K), q ≤ RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) ≤
      ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts hN ^ (q - 1) / ↑q.factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponentTail
type:
∀ {k N K B : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (hN : 2 ≤ N),
  2 ≤ B →
    ∀ {η A : ℝ},
      RiffleLowerV2.maximalMean cuts ⋯ ≤ ↑N ^ (-η) →
        A + 1 ≤ η * ↑B →
          (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              ¬RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) B) ≤
            ↑N ^ (-A) / ↑(B + 1).factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.prod_initialCard
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] (s : Finset α), ∏ i ∈ s, {j ∈ s | j ≤ i}.card = s.card.factorial

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → Fin N → ℕ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength_pos
type: ∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (i : Fin N), 0 < RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength G i

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial_eq_runProduct
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G = ∏ i : Fin N, RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength G i

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentIndex_eq_iff_between
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) {i j : Fin N},
  i ≤ j →
    (RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G i = RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G j ↔
      ∀ (e : Fin (N - 1)), ↑i ≤ ↑e → ↑e < ↑j → e ∈ G)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength_mono
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} {G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N},
  G ⊆ H → ∀ (i : Fin N), RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength G i ≤ RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength H i

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength_le_componentSize
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (i : Fin N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength G i ≤
    {j : Fin N | RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G j = RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentKey G i}.card

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength_eq_one_of_no_predecessor
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (i : Fin N),
  (∀ e ∈ G, RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e ≠ i) → RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.runLength G i = 1

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents
type: {N : ℕ} → RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N → ℕ → Prop

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponentFactorial
type:
∀ {N B : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents H B →
    RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial G * RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial H ≤
      RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentFactorial (G ∪ H) * B ^ Finset.card (G ∩ H)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponentOverlap_strong
type:
∀ {N B : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents H B → RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap G H ≤ ↑B ^ Finset.card (G ∩ H)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.boundedComponentOverlap
type:
∀ {N B : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N),
  2 ≤ B →
    RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.BoundedComponents H B →
      RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap G H ≤ ↑(B.choose (B / 2)) ^ Finset.card (G ∩ H)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.componentIndex_edge_eq_iff
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (e : Fin (N - 1)),
  RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) =
      RiffleLowerV2.componentIndex G (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e) ↔
    e ∈ G

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.blockIncreasing_iff_edges
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G σ ↔ ∀ e ∈ G, σ (RiffleLowerV2.edgeLeft e) < σ (RiffleLowerV2.edgeRight e)

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.blockIncreasing_union
type:
∀ {N : ℕ} (G H : RiffleUpperV2.PathEdges N) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing (G ∪ H) σ ↔
    RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing G σ ∧ RiffleLowerV2.Model.BlockIncreasing H σ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity
type: {Ω : Type u_1} → {Γ : Type u_2} → [Fintype Ω] → PMF Ω → (Ω → Prop) → (Ω → Γ → ℝ) → Γ → ℝ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity_mean
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (A : Ω → Prop)
  (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (f ω) = 1) →
    RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity P A f) = RiffleLowerV2.probability P A

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity_second
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (A : Ω → Prop)
  (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) => RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity P A f x ^ 2) =
    RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω' : Ω) =>
        if A ω ∧ A ω' then RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) => f ω x * f ω' x else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedVariance_eq
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (A : Ω → Prop)
  (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (f ω) = 1) →
    (RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) =>
        (RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensity P A f x - RiffleLowerV2.probability P A) ^ 2) =
      RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω' : Ω) =>
          if A ω ∧ A ω' then (RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) => f ω x * f ω' x) - 1 else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedRadicand_nonneg
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q : PMF Γ) (A : Ω → Prop)
  (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (f ω) = 1) →
    0 ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
        RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω' : Ω) =>
          if A ω ∧ A ω' then (RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) => f ω x * f ω' x) - 1 else 0

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedDensityTV
type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Γ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] [inst_1 : Fintype Γ] (P : PMF Ω) (Q R : PMF Γ) (A : Ω → Prop)
  (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ),
  (∀ (ω : Ω) (x : Γ), 0 ≤ f ω x) →
    (∀ (ω : Ω), RiffleLowerV2.expect Q (f ω) = 1) →
      (∀ (x : Γ), (R x).toReal = (Q x).toReal * RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => f ω x) →
        RiffleLowerV2.tv R Q ≤
          √(RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) =>
                  RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω' : Ω) =>
                    if A ω ∧ A ω' then (RiffleLowerV2.expect Q fun (x : Γ) => f ω x * f ω' x) - 1 else 0) /
              2 +
            RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => ¬A ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.physical_density
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (σ : RiffleUpperV2.Permutation N),
  ((RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) σ).toReal =
    ((RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) σ).toReal *
      RiffleLowerV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.density (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) σ

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.truncatedTV
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (S1 : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop),
  RiffleUpperV2.tv (RiffleUpperV2.physicalInverseLaw cuts) (RiffleUpperV2.uniformPermutation N) ≤
    √(RiffleUpperV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
            RiffleUpperV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω' : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              if S1 ω ∧ S1 ω' then
                RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω') - 1
              else 0) /
        2 +
      RiffleUpperV2.probability (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) => ¬S1 ω

name: RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.shuffleTruncatedRadicand_nonneg
type:
∀ {k N K : ℕ} (cuts : RiffleUpperV2.Cuts k N K) (S1 : RiffleUpperV2.Sample cuts → Prop),
  0 ≤
    RiffleUpperV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleUpperV2.expect (RiffleUpperV2.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω' : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        if S1 ω ∧ S1 ω' then
          RiffleUpperV2.GraphOverlap.overlap (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω) (RiffleUpperV2.shuffleEdges ω') - 1
        else 0
